text:
morgan: Quick nudge — release cutoff in ~48h (Fri 10:00 PT). Please add changelog entries before freeze. Use the repo template and the 'keep-a-changelog' headings. If your PR touches public APIs, include a short user-facing line and a migration note if needed.

sam: Quick Q — do we prefer 'Changed' or 'Updated' for behavior tweaks?

morgan: Use the canonical headings: Added, Changed, Fixed, Deprecated, Removed, Security. Keep lines short (one sentence) and include an owner tag like (infra) or (console).

lina: Heads-up — I just opened a tiny PR to normalize Yaml frontmatter on a couple entries (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1287). Ran into the changelog-lint check failing when there was no header.

devbot: changelog-lint: error: missing section header. Sample failing entry:
```
- improved batching for small requests
```
Needs to be:
```
### Changed
- improved batching for small requests (serving-runtime)
```

jordan: ETA on branch freeze? Is the cutover coordinated with the release job?

morgan: Freeze at Fri 10:00 PT. Release job will run on release/x.y branch at 13:00 PT. If you need a backport, open a backport PR and ping me + release-bot.

sam: pinging owners for a couple outstanding PRs that need changelog lines: #1292 @lina, #1298 @jordan. If you can't add a line, mark with "no-user-impact" in the PR body so QA knows.

lina: I'll add the lines today. Also, small reminder: keep the entry scope in parens e.g., (console) or (routing). Helps the release notes generator.

release-bot: scheduled reminder queued for 12:00 PT tomorrow. :bell:

morgan: If anyone runs into changelog-lint locally, run `npm run changelog:lint` — it gives autofix suggestions for spacing and headers. For anything ambiguous, paste the snippet in this thread and we'll quick-check. Thanks all! :rocket:
